verdict.rationale: First-party MCP tool docs confirm that custom fields exist as a native Asana object type, and an integration listing mentions syncing Asana custom fields. That is a thin, indirect sign that field customization is supported. No evidence describes how a PM creates or configures fields, and nothing covers customizable workflow statuses: the 'status updates' docs refer to status reports, not workflow states. Missing for 10: documentation of creating and editing custom fields, customizable workflow statuses or stages, process-mapping configuration, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: Searches tasks, projects, project templates, portfolios, goals, teams, users, tags, custom fields, and AI Teammates by name.
